scale: Placement on left right scale (lrscale): 0 = Left (links) ... 10 = Right (rechts); codes 77 Refusal, 88 Don't know, 99 No answer treated as missing
weighting: pspwght (post-stratification weight including design weight), the portal's default weight and the ESS-recommended weight for single-country analysis. anweight gives identical within-country shares (constant factor) but only integer-rounded counts of small magnitude, so pspwght was used for precision. Weighted counts are returned by the portal rounded to integers (rounding error <= about 0.03 percentage points per value).

countries.source_note: Gewichtete Häufigkeiten (pspwght) aus der ESS-Online-Analyse, Basis: gültige Antworten 0-10; Mittelwert und SD aus der gewichteten Verteilung berechnet. Ungewichtete Fallzahl n = gültige Antworten.

notes: Retrieved 2026-10-22 from the ESS Data Portal's public GraphQL API (api.nsd.no/graphql, FrequencyTabulation query, the same one behind the portal's Analysis tab); no login needed. Raw responses in raw-ess/.
Shares are percent of valid answers (0-10); missing_share is percent of all respondents (weighted) who gave no valid answer.
Mean and SD are computed by us from the published weighted frequency table, not published by ESS directly; SD is the population SD of the weighted distribution.
Self-placement is self-reported and shows the value 5 as the modal answer in all three countries (partly a 'middle/no position' answer); do not read as a measure of actual policy positions.
Direct data-file download requires ESS login; not attempted.
_note: ESS Runde 11, Links-Rechts-Selbsteinstufung (lrscale), gewichtet; abgerufen 2026-10-22 über die ESS-Online-Analyse. Nicht von Hand ändern.
